item.description:
Two more minutes when a thought isn't finished, and more choice on the break screen.

New

  • “+2m” on the final-minute countdown — once per round, whether there or with “2 min later” on the break screen
  • “Already took my break”: if you were already away from the screen, you go straight to the next block after a minute, and the break counts

Improved

  • “Other exercise” opens a list of all five microbreaks instead of one fixed switch
  • Pick the breathing rhythm right before you start — through the exercise's title, for this break only
  • Tidier start screens: one start button, with the alternatives in a single row below

Fixed

  • Stopping a postponed block from the menu took away the postponement in the next block
